notes: «حدثني من، سمع عطاء» is an unnamed link (rule 8): the text does not name who heard Ata', so the gap stays «من»
«أخبرني أبي» is the father of Abbas: a relation link
the Awza'i remark («قال الأوزاعي سمعت عطاء ... فأثبته لي») is a note on how the report was checked, not a further route; left out
the last link is Jabir, the Prophet's Hajj report relayed in his words
